SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CAPE MAY COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000351
DOCKET NO. F-787-26
PLAINTIFF – WILMINGTON SAVINGS FUND SOCIETY, FSB, NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY BUT SOLELY AS TRUSTEE OF ARUGULA FUNDING TITLING TRUST
DEFENDANTS- SOPHIA ALBRECHT, ET AL.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 6th DAY OF January 2027
At 1:00 o'clock in the afternoon at the old Courthouse building located at 9 N Main Street (Route 9), in Cape May Court House, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the TOWNSHIP OF MIDDLE of Cape May Court House, County of Cape May and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 18, 19 & 20 FKA 1.01, 1.02, 1.03, BLOCK 95.03 FKA 95.04
Dimensions of Lot: 3.30AC / 2.18AC/ 1.20AC
Nearest Cross Street: Easy Street
OWNER OCCUPIED
Estimated Upset Bid amount: $161,000.00, plus any additional sums as ordered by the court.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
417 COURTHOUSE DENNISVILLE A/K/A 417 CH SO DENNIS RD AND 427 CH SO DENNIS RD AND 423 CH SO DENNIS RD, Cape May Court House, NJ 08210
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Cape May County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: Lot 18 Block 95.03- 2026 Qtr 3 Due: 8/1/2026 $3,021.39 OPEN, 2026 Qtr 4 Due: 11/1/2026 $3,021.39 OPEN, 2027 Qtr 1 Due: 2/1/2027 $2,894.65 OPEN, 2027 Qtr 2 Due: 5/1/2027 $2,894.64 OPEN
Lot 19 Block 95.03; Vacant Land- 2026 Qtr 3 Due: 8/1/2027 $807.12 OPEN, 2026 Qtr 4 Due: 11/1/2026 $807.12 OPEN, 2027 Qtr 1 Due: 2/1/2027 $773.27 OPEN, 2027 Qtr 2 Due: 5/1/2027 $773.26 OPEN
Lot 20 Block 95.03; Vacant Land- 2026 Qtr 3 Due: 8/1/2026 $749.30 OPEN, 2026 Qtr 4 Due: 11/1/2026 $749.30 OPEN, 2027 Qtr 1 Due: 2/1/2027 $717.87 OPEN, 2027 Qtr 2 Due: 5/1/2027 $717.87 OPEN
PROSPECTIVE PURCHASERS ARE ON NOTICE THAT ANY PURCHASE IS SUBJECT TO A PRIOR MORTGAGE TO MORTGAGE ELECTRONIC REGISTRATION SYSTEMS, INC. ACTINF SOLELY AS NOMINEE FOR SUN HOME LOANS, INC. IN THE ORIGINAL AMOUNT OF $417,000.00 RECORDED ON 12/8/2008 IN BOOK M4813 AT PAGE 708. SAID MORTGAGE WAS ASSIGNED BY MESNE ASSIGMENTS. THE LAST ASSIGNMENT WAS FROM SPECIALIZED LOAN SERVICING LLC TO FEDERAL HOME MORTGAGE CORPORATION AS TRUSTEE FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE SEASONED CREDIT RISK TRANSFER TRUST, SERIES 2018-2 BY ASSIGNMENT DATED 5/13/20 RECORDED 6/18/20 WITH THE CAPE MAY COUNTY CLERK/REGISTER IN BK A 357 PG 491
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Cape May County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any. The approximate amount due on this execution is $144,438.08 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Robert A. Nolan, SHERIFF DATED: September 9, 2026
Ras Citron, LLC
130 Clinton Road, Suite 202
Fairfield, NJ 07004
973-575-0707
